quotes.text: I'm a Cheesecake Lover and the Pistachio and the Dubai Cheesecake are my favorite and the cashews are flavorful as well.
quotes.name: Ethelyn K.

quotes.text: They have such a unique selection of exotic sweets, chocolates, nuts, and so much more. … They were incredibly welcoming, let us sample so many different treats, and were so patient and kind throughout our visit.
quotes.name: Nidalia O.

quotes.text: I travel all the way from northern Kentucky to come to this store. They have amazing cheesecakes and viral fruit desserts.
quotes.name: Ben C.

quotes.text: I would give these guys a 10 star if it was available,  extremely awesome service and a more awesome selection of any candies, nuts, cakes ice creams in one place.
quotes.name: Alexis M.

quotes.text: Absolute gem in the concrete jungle. … The cheesecakes are incredible and the mango fruit shaped cake was spectacular.
